question: What analogy illustrates how the designated person should be protected?
premises: A mother protects her own son.
The son may be born from a lover.
This protection serves as a comparison.
inference: The person should be protected as a mother protects her own son even if born from a lover.
uncertainties: The referent of the one to be protected is implied from the previous verse.
plain_english: One should protect him just as a mother protects her own son, even if born from a lover.
